name: place_order
description: Buy one item and stop before the final charge. Deliberately does not pay.
triggers: check out with this in the cart

preconditions.notes: A recipe that starts on an empty cart would fail on its first step in a way that reads like the site being broken.
A login wall at the wrong point means the recipe was written for a different session shape.

steps.intent: go to checkout from the cart
steps.notes: Safe: nothing is charged until the last step of the last page.

steps.intent: read the total so a human can check it before paying
steps.notes: A read. The number is the whole point of stopping here.

steps.intent: pay: place the order and charge the card
steps.notes: The one irreversible step. Everything above it was reversible, which is the entire reason this recipe is shaped the way it is.
